theme_archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Modified for Elite ERP
design_philosophy: A high-density, authoritative dashboard. Instead of floating generic cards, use structural grid lines and tight spacing. The UI should feel like a high-end precision tool (like a Bloomberg terminal or aviation software), not a generic SaaS. Optimize for readability, data scanning, and high contrast.

rules: No Inter for headings. Use Manrope to add technical yet accessible character.
IBM Plex Sans for all body and table text to ensure perfect number alignment and legibility.
Use tabular-nums class for all data columns.
Do not default to bold for headers; use radical weight contrast (e.g., Black vs Regular).
Pure Black/Void Black for Dark Mode backgrounds to increase contrast.
Primary color (Cobalt Blue) is used STRICTLY for primary CTAs and active states.
Never use Teal or Space Grotesk.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays.

layouts.shell: Full-height left sidebar (260px) + Main Content Area. Mobile-first responsive using a hamburger menu for smaller screens.
layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid. Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
layouts.pages: Table-first surfaces. CRUD pages should not bury data inside padded cards. Use edge-to-edge tables within the main content container.
rules: Max 8px border-radius globally for interactive elements, 0px for structural containers.
Ensure optical alignment. Form labels and inputs left-aligned.
Use 'Grid Borders' look: subtle 1px borders separating sections instead of heavy drop shadows.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Instead of floating boxes with drop shadows, use 1px solid borders (border-border) to define zones.
visual_enhancers.super_admin_switcher: The Super Admin Company Dropdown MUST be the most distinct interactive element in the sidebar. Apply the 'Glassmorphism (Crystal)' styling to its container: backdrop-blur-xl, bg-white/70 (light) or bg-black/60 (dark), 1px delicate inner stroke, and a subtle drop shadow to signify authority and global control. If standard user, render as a flat, unclickable text badge.
visual_enhancers.login_screen: Split screen layout. Right side: Login form (white/black solid). Left side: Full bleed architectural abstract image with a soft gradient overlay.

components.tables: Shadcn Table heavily customized. Very dense (py-2 px-3). Remove outer borders, keep row bottom borders. Hover state: slight tint background.
components.modals_forms: Use Shadcn 'Sheet' (Slide-over) for all major Create/Edit forms (User, Product, Employee, etc.). Only use center Dialogs for quick confirmations (e.g., Delete).
components.dropdowns: Shadcn Dropdown Menu or Select. Must have solid background (bg-card), border, and shadow. No transparent dropdowns.
components.buttons: Sharp or max 8px radius. Active hover states must lighten/darken clearly.
components.badges: Use sharp rectangular badges for Roles and Statuses (e.g., Active/Inactive).

motion.transitions: Specific property transitions only (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease). NEVER use transition-all.
motion.hover_states: All interactive rows and buttons must have distinct hover states with increased contrast.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for list/table rows on page load (framer-motion or simple CSS animation).

accessibility.contrast: APCA contrast optimized. Text over gradients/images needs text-shadow or solid background.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Example: data-testid='super-admin-company-select', data-testid='submit-login-button'.

media_and_icons.icon_library: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone style for premium feel) or lucide-react if strictly preferred. Ensure consistent sizing.

login_background.description: Minimalist geometric architecture. Use as the massive left-side hero image on the Login page to signify scale, structure, and enterprise stability.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Create a toggle for Light/Dark theme. Default to Light theme for ERP functionality.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications (located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx or install if missing).
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) for icons.
Implement the 'Company Context' securely in the Session State and automatically attach it to all form submits.
For the 10 CRUD profile pages, use a consistent Table + Sheet pattern. Do not build 10 different layout styles. Create a reusable generic Table layout component if possible.
Use 2-3x more spacing (padding/margin) on structural elements than you think is necessary, but keep table data dense.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind config with the provided color variables (Light/Dark).
2. Setup routing for Login, Dashboard, and the 10 Setup/Profile pages.
3. Build the Auth/Session Context Provider. The user object MUST contain role and company_id.
4. Build the Left Sidebar containing navigation and the prominent Super Admin Company Switcher.
5. Build a reusable CRUD layout template (Table + Slide-over Form).
6. Implement the 10 profiles using this layout.
7. Ensure data-testid attributes are present on every button, input, and row action.
